+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Native OMP2 as Executor (ADR 0052 D5)
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+/// Native OMP2 executor that runs phases through the child-kernel path.
+///
+/// This implements the [`Executor`] trait so that native OMP2 can be used
+/// behind the same interface as delegated executors. A workflow can move a
+/// phase between native and delegated without edits.
+///
+/// Currently used via the dispatch path in `ProductionAdwHost::dispatch()`
+/// which routes executor id "native" to `run_child`. The struct provides
+/// a standalone executor for future use (ADR 0052 D5).
+#[allow(dead_code)]
+pub struct NativeOmp {
+	/// Path to the project's data directory.
+	data_dir:        PathBuf,
+	/// Project root.
+	root:            PathBuf,
+	/// Convar context.
+	ctx:             Arc<omp_con::Ctx>,
+	/// Workspace trust decision.
+	workspace_trust: TrustDecision,
+	/// Model selector for phases.
+	model:           Str,
+	/// Whether the model selector was explicitly set.
+	model_override:  bool,
+}
+
+impl NativeOmp {
+	/// Creates a new native executor from the production host's configuration.
+	#[must_use]
+	pub fn from_host(host: &ProductionAdwHost) -> Self {
+		Self {
+			data_dir:        host.data_dir.clone(),
+			root:            host.root.clone(),
+			ctx:             Arc::clone(&host.ctx),
+			workspace_trust: host.workspace_trust.clone(),
+			model:           host.model.clone(),
+			model_override:  host.model_override,
+		}
+	}
+
+	/// Runs one turn using the child-kernel path and returns the assistant's
+	/// final text.
+	async fn run_turn(
+		&self,
+		prompt: Str,
+		kind: PhaseKind,
+		cancel: &CancellationToken,
+	) -> Result<Str, ProductionError> {
+		let (model, model_override) = self.model_phase_selector_for(kind);
+		let _restore =
+			(model_override && !self.model_override).then(|| RestoreModel::capture(&self.ctx));
+		let (mut kernel, mut session, _) = compose_kernel(
+			&self.data_dir,
+			&self.root,
+			model,
+			Arc::clone(&self.ctx),
+			child_kernel_options(&self.workspace_trust, model_override),
+		)
+		.await?;
+		let outcome = kernel
+			.run_turn(
+				&mut session,
+				omp_agent::TurnInput { text: prompt, attachments: Vec::new() },
+				omp_agent::RunControl::new(cancel.clone(), None),
+			)
+			.await?;
+		Ok(outcome.assistant_text)
+	}
+
+	fn model_phase_selector(&self) -> (&str, bool) {
+		(self.model.as_str(), self.model_override)
+	}
+
+	fn model_phase_selector_for(&self, kind: PhaseKind) -> (&str, bool) {
+		if kind == PhaseKind::Review && !self.model_override {
+			return ("@judge", true);
+		}
+		self.model_phase_selector()
+	}
+}

+# Agent Skills vs OMP discovery (current behavior)
+
+Owner: `crates/driver/src/discovery/skills.rs`.  
+Spec reference: [agentskills.io/specification](https://agentskills.io/specification).  
+This document locks **observable discovery behavior**. It does not authorize tools, models, or network access. Skill YAML never expands admission authority.
+
+## Dual frontmatter regimes
+
+| Field / rule | Default / Claude / agents path (`SkillHeader`) | Agent Plugins path (`AgentPluginSkillHeader`) |
+|---|---|---|
+| `name` | Optional; directory fallback; may include `_` `.` and mixed case | Required; kebab + directory match rules (plugin layout) |
+| `description` | Required to admit; **no** 1024-char length clamp | Required; no 1024 clamp |
+| `license` | Ignored (unknown → dropped) | Validated (non-empty if present) then **discarded** |
+| `compatibility` | Ignored | Validated (≤500 chars if present) then **discarded** |
+| `metadata` | Ignored | Validated (no empty keys) then **discarded** |
+| `allowed-tools` | Ignored | Empty string rejected; otherwise parsed then **discarded**; **not enforced** on admission |
+| Unknown keys | Silently dropped | `deny_unknown_fields` → hard fail |
+| OMP `enabled` / `hide` / `disable-model-invocation` | Honored | Unknown on plugin header → hard fail |
+
+Stored `Skill` retains: name, description, paths, provider, level, hidden, body. Optional Agent Skills fields are **not** retained today.
+
+## Progressive disclosure
+
+Prompt facts expose name + description. Bodies load via `/skill:` / `skill://`. Source ladder and first-wins collision policy live in `discover` / `ActiveSkills`.
+
+## Intentional non-goals (until an ADR says otherwise)
+
+- Wiring `allowed-tools` into ApprovalBook / roster admission.  
+- Treating `compatibility` or `metadata` as model/tool preflight gates.  
+- A second skill registry outside driver discovery.

+# Structured operations (native path)
+
+Owners: `omp-shell`, `omp-shell-builtins` (`jq` via jaq), `omp-envd` exec/spill, `omp-minimizer`, `omp-tool` projection.
+
+## What agents use today
+
+- In-process Bash (ADR 0028) with embedded builtins — not `/bin/bash` first.  
+- Native `jq` builtin: CLI front-end ported from jaq 2.3.0 docs; locked crates are `jaq-core` / `jaq-std` / `jaq-json` as resolved in `Cargo.lock` (versions may differ from the CLI-port comment).  
+- Text filters (`sed`, `cut`, `sort`, `uniq`, `grep`, `rg`, …).  
+- Tool spill / `artifact://` projection for large shell output.  
+- Live model-facing minimize in envd is **cargo-only** (`envd/src/exec.rs`); jq minimizer defs exist in `omp-minimizer` but are not the live gate.
+
+## Non-goals
+
+- Embedding or shelling out to **sHEL** (Windows `cmd.exe` literal-safety / AGPL workstation — wrong domain for OMP2).  
+- A second structured-data interpreter or dedicated roster JSON tool unless bash+`jq` fails a measured workload.  
+- Treating `omp_core::slopjson` as a general query language (tool-arg streaming only).
+
+## Related composition note
+
+Durable gated multi-phase work uses **ADW** (`omp-adw` + `.omp/workflows`). Soft `omp.workflows` (`extensions/workflows`, `workflow@1`) is an optional long-tail subagent DAG — not the expert packaging story. Durable **schedules** exist as API surface but production delivery is **disarmed**; prefer `ci@1` `watch` poll for CI waiting.
